say:1:1732252001:1.text: I know, right! I used to bring my owner here to enjoy the breeze.
say:1:1732252001:1.source_cn: 那当然喵！以前喵会带着主人一起来这里吹风！
say:1:1732252001:1.male: I know, right! I used to bring my owner here to enjoy the breeze.
say:1:1732252001:1.female: I know, right! I used to bring my owner here to enjoy the breeze.

say:2:1732252002:1.text: Besides my owner, you're the only human who's ever set foot here!
say:2:1732252002:1.source_cn: 除了主人，你是唯一一个找到这里的人类喵！
say:2:1732252002:1.male: Besides my owner, you're the only human who's ever set foot here!
say:2:1732252002:1.female: Besides my owner, you're the only human who's ever set foot here!

say:3:1732252003:1.text: You're a nice person! You're officially my good friend from now on!
say:3:1732252003:1.source_cn: 喵很欣赏你，从今天起你就是喵的好朋喵！
say:3:1732252003:1.male: You're a nice person! You're officially my good friend from now on!
say:3:1732252003:1.female: You're a nice person! You're officially my good friend from now on!
